text:
nora: heads-up 1 i'm landing a quick docs PR to clean up model cards for opal5b and zenith9b. need: alias mapping, short SDK v4+CLI migration snippets, and a tiny benchmark footnote. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/5123
felix: nice. runtime gave ceilings: opal5b(fp16)=6144, opal5b-quant=4096, zenith9b(fp16)=8192, zenith9b-quant=6144. label them "variant-dependent" and link to /data/model-catalog.csv.
li: i'll add the tiny snippets. keep examples compact and show resolveVariant + graceful fallback. also replace any `sequence_limit` keys with `max_sequence_length` in the examples.
ops: ops request: do not flip any deprecation banners for legacy aliases until we've cleared pinned reservations. docs can include the banner behind a flag with a scheduled flip date.
nora: understood. i'll put the banner behind a feature flag and add a TODO with the maintenance window date.
felix: include a short benchmark note comparing q4_0 vs fp16 at bsz=1 and bsz=16, with footnote: "throughput varies by GPU family and kernel selection". don't embed large tables.
li: snippet draft (SDK v4 compact):
```js
// SDK v4: resolve variant, prefer quantized, fallback to compat alias
const v = await client.models.resolveVariant('opal5b', { preferQuantized: true });
try { const r = await client.generate({ model: v, input: prompt }); console.log(r.generated_text); }
catch(e) { const r2 = await client.generate({ model: 'opal5b-compat-q4_0', input: prompt }); console.log(r2.generated_text); }
```
li: CLI example (one-liner):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"opal5b:compat-q4_0","input":"..."}'
```
nora: i'll also add a short embed snippet showing shardHint for large corpora and a small compatibility paragraph: "If a requested variant is unavailable, the runtime will pick the closest compatible alias (e.g., compat-q4_0)."
doc-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs.io/pr-5123 (CI #12250) :white_check_mark:
ops: confirmed we'll hold the banner flip until pinned reservations are cleared; target window FRIDAY EOD. please leave the banner behind a flag.
felix: small editorial nit: remove trailing commas in JSON examples and use `max_sequence_length` in YAML frontmatter. i'll push that tweak after a quick review.
nora: thanks all. plan: small edits now, wait for ops to confirm pinned alias clearance, then flip the banner on Friday. ping here if anything blocks.
